name: IINA
tagline: Play your videos, music, and subtitles in a free player designed for macOS.
description:
IINA is a free, open-source media player built specifically for macOS. It combines the broad file-format support and playback engine of mpv with an interface, gestures, and system behavior designed to feel at home on a Mac.

It is useful when a video or audio file does not open cleanly in QuickTime, or when you want more control without accepting a generic cross-platform player. IINA can handle local media, playlists, subtitles, picture-in-picture, and online streams while keeping the main controls close to familiar macOS conventions.

## Features

- Play a wide range of local video and audio formats through mpv’s media engine, including files that QuickTime may not support.
- Control playback with macOS-style gestures, Touch Bar support where available, picture-in-picture, and a polished dark-mode interface.
- Load, search, and adjust subtitle tracks, including options for timing, font, and placement when a file needs correction.
- Build playlists, remember playback position, and use chapters or media controls to move through longer content.
- Open online video and audio sources supported by the current mpv and IINA configuration.
- Extend the player with plugins and user scripts when a specialized workflow needs more than the default interface.

## Where it fits

IINA is ideal for Mac users who want a capable local-media player without the dated feel of many universal players. It is especially useful for downloaded video, subtitle-heavy content, and unusual file formats.

It is not a replacement for subscription streaming apps with protected playback or library management. Advanced mpv-style configuration can also be more technical than a simple player requires.

## Privacy and requirements

The current IINA release requires macOS 12 on Apple-silicon Macs or macOS 10.15 on Intel Macs. Local playback does not require an account, but online streams, subtitle searches, browser extensions, plugins, and youtube-dl integrations make network requests to their respective services. Treat third-party plugins and remote media URLs as separate trust decisions.

## Pricing

IINA is free and open source.
